fields.note: KNOWN, pinned by the test: no visible words name the résumé (its opener a.button.resume in the apply buttons reads "Attached" once a file is in; its words before that are in no snapshot), so it reads with no label and is the person's. Its display:none input is required; the opener is the adapter's upload control.

fields.label: Full Name
fields.note: Titled by the h3 just before it (the placeholder repeats it); required by its required attribute and the h3's star.

fields.label: By providing your phone number you agree to receive informational text messages from Concurrent Technologies Corporation. Concurrent Technologies Corporation will send updates about your application via SMS. Message & data rates may apply, reply STOP to opt out at any time.
fields.note: A lone consent box, its words the span beside it (ng-bind getSmsConsentText()).

fields.label: Desired Salary currency
fields.note: One h3 (Desired Salary) titles three controls; the currency select (ng-model candidate.salary.currency) is told apart by "currency".

fields.label: Desired Salary period
fields.note: The period select (ng-model candidate.salary.period, no name): "period".

fields.label: Cover Letter
fields.note: Titled by the div.section-header before it (no placeholder).

fields.label: Race or Ethnicity
fields.note: Required while unanswered (ng-required="!eeoc.race_ethnicity"; its required attribute comes and goes with the answer).

fields.label: Veteran status
fields.note: Titled by the h3 above the legal text that separates it from its radios.
The honeypot (div.apply-field-extra: aria-hidden, 9999 px off the left, opacity 0): never a field.
